title: CRISIS_FADE16 byte-duplicates EASE16; the deliberate-independence rationale lives only in the PR body, not at the table
detail: The PR records "its own table (not a reuse of the gauge EASE16) so a future gauge retune cannot shift crisis timing" — but the identical bytes invite a future deduplicate-refactor that silently re-couples them. No comment at either table states the intent.
recommended_fix: Add one comment line at CRISIS_FADE16: "deliberately NOT shared with gauge EASE16 — a gauge retune must never shift crisis timing" (and mirror at EASE16).

title: Dublin block recede applies BOTH RGB mix and alpha twin — GPU app recedes deeper than the rlsw-pinned goldens, untracked in deferred-work
detail: rlsw renders the fill opaque (goldens pin RGB-mix-only); the GPU app additionally blends the 0.35 alpha, so shipped Dublin blocks recede deeper than every other surface — invisible to goldens. The sibling winding bug got a deferred-work entry; this divergence got only a comment.
recommended_fix: Add a deferred-work entry for GPU-side crisis Dublin verification/tuning (mirror the backface-culling entry), or drop the alpha twin so both renderers agree.
